title: Reptile Humidity Recovery After Door Open
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reptilethermostat:event
| search event="door_open" recovery_min=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(recovery_min) as avg_recovery_min max(recovery_min) as max_recovery_min by _time enclosure_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks humidity recovery after door-open events over time and breaks it out by enclosure.
value: Recovery after disturbance is more informative than absolute humidity alone because it tests the enclosure's resilience.
implementation: Send humidity recovery after door-open events events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of humidity recovery after door-open events by enclosure.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how humidity recovery after door-open events changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
